args.query: board deck FP&A variance software subscriptions US

args.text:
MEMO - US Software Subscriptions (GL 6200), Q1 2026: Board deck vs. GL
Prepared by: david.murguia@gmail.com | Date: 2026-04-03 | Entity: Halvard Systems Inc. (US) | No postings made (analysis only, per instruction)

1. THE DECK NUMBER AND ITS SOURCE
DOC-0207 "Q1 2026 board deck - Appendix B: US operating expense detail" reports Software Subscriptions (GL 6200) Q1 2026 = USD 11,769.00. The document states it was "Prepared by FP&A from the general ledger as of 2026-04-01 09:00."

2. THE GL TODAY
US GL 6200 activity, 2026-01-01 to 2026-03-31 (19 entries, all posted, all with support):
  Jan-2026 activity:  4,289.70
  Feb-2026 activity:  4,139.80
  Mar-2026 activity:  6,139.50
  Q1 2026 total:     14,569.00  (ties to ending balance at 2026-03; account opened Q1 at zero)

Difference vs. deck: 14,569.00 - 11,769.00 = USD 2,800.00 (deck understated).

3. WHAT EXPLAINS THE DIFFERENCE - 100% IDENTIFIED, SINGLE ITEM
JE-00304, dated 2026-03-31, "Tessellate BI - TB-Q1-TRUEUP - Q1 seat true-up," Dr 6200 / Cr 2000 AP, USD 2,800.00.
  - Support: DOC-0206, Tessellate BI invoice TB-Q1-TRUEUP dated 2026-03-31, "Q1 2026 seat true-up (14 additional seats, Jan-Mar)," USD 2,800.00.
  - Posted by ap.clerk with created_at 2026-04-02 10:14 - i.e. roughly 25 hours AFTER the 2026-04-01 09:00 GL snapshot FP&A used.

This is a timing/cut-off difference in the deck's data pull, not a GL error. The entry is correctly dated 2026-03-31 and correctly belongs in Q1: the invoice covers additional seats consumed Jan-Mar 2026, so the expense is properly matched to the Q1 service period. The variance reconciles exactly to the cent, with no residual:
  Deck 11,769.00 + JE-00304 2,800.00 = 14,569.00 = current GL. Difference fully explained.

4. ITEMS RULED OUT (tested, not drivers of the variance)
  a) Apparent duplicate Zoom charge: JE-00247 and JE-00248 are both dated 2026-03-08 for USD 149.90 with near-identical receipts (DOC-0174 and DOC-0173). I traced these to the bank: BT-US-0062 and BT-US-0063, two separate "CARD ZOOM" debits of -149.90 on 2026-03-08. March bank activity shows five Zoom charges (3/02, 3/08 x2, 3/20, 3/27) matching the five GL Zoom entries one-for-one. Both entries are legitimate and bank-confirmed; no duplicate, no write-off required.
  b) Monthly vendor completeness: all three recurring US software vendors are booked for each of Jan/Feb/Mar - Tessellate BI (JE-00027 / JE-00140 / JE-00237) and Quire Docs (JE-00035 / JE-00127 / JE-00229), each at contracted monthly rates. No missing or double-booked monthly bills.
  c) No FX component - US entity is USD functional, so the policy rates in DOC-0200 are not in play.

5. ONE FURTHER ITEM AFFECTING THE FINAL Q1 FIGURE (not a deck-vs-GL difference)
The March prepaid software amortization has not yet been booked. Per DOC-0067 (Prepaid software amortization schedule 2026, US): Figtree Platform annual license, invoice FIG-20260105, USD 15,000.00, term 2026-01-01 to 2026-12-31, straight-line at USD 1,250.00/month, Dr 6200 / Cr 1210. The schedule itself states "Jan-2026: booked, Feb-2026: booked, Mar-2026: to be booked at March close." Corroborating evidence:
  - Jan and Feb were booked via JE-00108 and JE-00204 (1,250.00 each).
  - GL 1210 Prepaid Software shows zero activity in Mar-2026 and an ending balance of 12,500.00 = 15,000.00 less only two months of amortization.
  - US close checklist item "Amortize prepaid software" (2026-03) remains OPEN.
This affects both the deck figure and the current GL equally, so it is not part of the 2,800.00 reconciling difference - but it must be posted before Q1 is final. I have not posted it, per the no-postings instruction; it remains assigned on the March checklist.

6. CONFIRMED CORRECT Q1 2026 FIGURE
  Board deck as presented (GL snapshot 2026-04-01 09:00):        11,769.00
  Add: Tessellate BI Q1 seat true-up, JE-00304 / DOC-0206:        2,800.00
  GL as it stands today (2026-04-03):                            14,569.00
  Add: March Figtree prepaid amortization, per DOC-0067 (unbooked) 1,250.00
  CORRECT Q1 2026 US SOFTWARE SUBSCRIPTIONS (GL 6200):           15,819.00

The board deck understates US Q1 software subscription spend by USD 4,050.00 against the properly closed figure - 2,800.00 from the late-posted Tessellate true-up and 1,250.00 from the not-yet-booked March prepaid amortization.

7. RECOMMENDATIONS
  - Restate Appendix B of the Q1 board deck to USD 15,819.00 (or 14,569.00 if the deck must reflect the GL strictly as posted at the time of issue, with the 1,250.00 flagged as a known open close item).
  - Instruct FP&A not to pull board figures from the GL before the close checklist is complete; the 2026-04-01 09:00 snapshot preceded normal AP cut-off posting.
  - Post the March Figtree amortization (Dr 6200 / Cr 1210, USD 1,250.00, support DOC-0067) as part of the March close and mark the "Amortize prepaid software" checklist item complete.
  - Note for AP cut-off review: the Tessellate true-up sits in AP (GL 2000) at 2026-03-31 and is unpaid at quarter end; confirm it is included in the March AP balance and payables roll-forward.

No exceptions were flagged: every item in GL 6200 for Q1 is supported by a source document, the full 2,800.00 variance is explained by a single identified entry, and no forced or unsupportable reconciling adjustment was required.
